ETH.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
AI named only in education for teachers, not in general administration.

facts.fact: Education Minister Berhanu Nega says Ethiopia has begun integrating AI into the education system, with teachers supported to use AI tools for lesson preparation, content development, student support and assessment.

ETH.note: No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.
Digital literacy effort named is for students and teachers, not a civil-service programme.
Data centres are mentioned only as being strengthened; no data centre for hire stated.
Digital literacy effort is for students and teachers, not a national programme for the public.
Only a general aim to connect data; no link between named education systems is stated.

facts.fact: Education Minister Berhanu Nega says significant efforts have been made to digitalize education information systems including the EMIS and HEMIS, which are being strengthened to organize and connect data on students, teachers, institutions and outcomes.

ETH.note: No nationally owned data centre for hire is stated.
No school internet figure or compulsory curriculum statement.
EMIS named without saying what it does at school level; unclassified.
